name: scene-feedback-harness
description: Review reference images and reconstructed scenes, annotate visual errors, and deliver image feedback through MCP tools and events.

defaultPrompt: 进入人工调试模式，让我在参考图和当前场景上指出问题。
Review this reconstruction with annotated visual feedback.
interface.longDescription: Compare reference images with reconstructed 3D scenes, mark visual errors, and share original and annotated evidence through a project-specific MCP service. Type @ in one prompt to reference objects, parts, annotations, frozen images and source-bound human evidence. The workbench supports multiple camera views, dynamic frames, imported WholeBody133 evidence and manual hand keypoint corrections. Human reconstruction and tracking run in a separate capsule skill. Experimental MCP Events delivery requires a supporting host and a verified subscription.
